name: build-journey-architecture
example-prompts: Compile the storefront journeys and scaffold the architecture for every detected journey.
Run the graph that prepares the journey API architecture from the existing journey runs.

instructions: Use global-designs as the run/<domain> name.
Use only the journeys array returned by the previous job.
Pass every journey identifier to the script with a repeated --journey option.
Do not read a managed output file to discover or normalize journey identifiers.
